meta.rootTitle: Soundie — Presence Pass | Heal with Living Notes
meta.rootDescription: Soundie: a meditative healing-sound Tamagotchi. Presence Pass — a refinement layer that makes sound feel alive. Twelve living notes, lore, and breath. It is also a tone of affirmation and a correlational intention mechanism.
meta.homeTitle: Soundie — Sound that knows you're here
meta.homeDescription: A meditative world of living notes. Each frequency heals something different — a tone of affirmation and a correlational intention mechanism in sound. The longer you listen, the more it reveals.
meta.playDescription: Listen to living notes. Your healing sound Tamagotchi.
meta.sanctuaryDescription: A quiet reflection of your listening: time with each emotional tone, and the moods you named before play.

landing.subhead: When your mind is overloaded, Soundie helps you return to yourself through a simple listening ritual. One note. One moment. Real nervous-system relief.
landing.narrativeWhatP1: Soundie is something that didn't exist before.
landing.narrativeWhatP2: Not a meditation app. Not a music game. Not a focus timer.
landing.narrativeWhatP3: It's a living world of sound — twelve notes, each with its own soul, its own ancient story, and its own effect on your nervous system. You listen to them. They grow. And in return — something in you settles.
landing.narrativeHowFlow: Choose a note → Listen → The note grows → Lore is revealed
landing.narrativeHowIntro: Each session is one repetition of a ritual:
landing.narrativeHowBullet1: Sound generated in real time — Web Audio API, no audio files, no loops
landing.narrativeHowBullet2: Five lore layers per note — unlocked through listening time, not payments
landing.narrativeHowBullet3: The Teardrop Deck — artifact cards tied to each note's emotional tone, earned through practice
landing.narrativeHowBullet4: Echo — your mirror: time with each emotional climate, moods, and your Teardrop path
landing.narrativeHowBullet5: Tree — your living garden of notes
landing.narrativeHowClosing: There's no rush. The stiller you sit — the more is revealed.
landing.narrativeTeardropP1: Every listening session edges you closer to cards from the Teardrop Deck — a layered collection tied to phases of the inner journey.
landing.narrativeTeardropP2: Each card is not a reward. It's a mirror — showing you what you just moved through while listening. Taglines, affirmations, shadow readings: reflection, not fortune-telling.
landing.narrativeDifferentQuote: The app does not demand your attention. It rewards your stillness.
landing.narrativeDifferent1: No "come back or lose your streak" notifications
landing.narrativeDifferent2: No energy bar that depletes overnight
landing.narrativeDifferent3: No ads hidden behind a pause button
landing.narrativeDifferentClosing: Notes unlock through listening — not paying. The longer you stay, the more you receive. That's the only mechanic that matters.
landing.narrativeWorldP1: Soundie exists in a world almost identical to ours — same cities, same oceans, same history. But hidden beneath ordinary life is an older layer of reality: resonance.
landing.narrativeWorldP2: Ancient cultures found that tones, intervals, and harmonic relationships touch biology, emotion, memory, and states of consciousness. Much of that knowledge was fragmented, buried, or forgotten.
landing.narrativeWorldP3: Soundie is the rediscovery. You don't collect monsters. You awaken Acoustic Archetypes — living entities formed where frequency and human attention meet.
landing.narrativeStack: Built with Next.js, tRPC, Prisma, Web Audio API, and care.
landing.tapHint: Tap a note and listen for a moment
landing.ariaNoteGroup: Listen to a note from the Soundie scale
landing.step1Body: Choose a note. Stay with it. The frequency does the rest.
landing.step2Body: Each session feeds your note. It deepens, slowly, like memory.
landing.step3Body: Lore unlocks as time passes. The note tells you what it knows.
landing.inviteFallbackAffirmation: Step in gently. This note has a message for you today.
landing.closing: Soundie does not demand your attention. It rewards your stillness, your affirmation, and the intention you bring.
landing.footerTagline: Soundie — healing in a tone of affirmation and correlative intention.

C: Before there was music, there was silence. C is the first breath after that quiet — the note from which everything begins.
Pythagoreans held C to be the first emanation of the cosmos. They said the stars heard this sound before the planets were born.
Ancient Egyptians tuned their harps to C, believing this frequency resonates with the base of the spine — where the body meets the earth.
In Tibetan practice C matches the root chakra. Monks sang it before meditation to ground the mind in the body.
C is the start of the scale for a reason. It is the note whose waves most easily sync to the heart rate of a person at rest. You listen. It listens back.
C#: C# remembers. It is the note that holds everything that was forgotten — names, rituals, the gestures of hands no one makes anymore.
From Stonehenge to the circle at Avebury, monoliths make acoustic resonance near the frequency of C#. Stone speaks. We stopped listening.
In shamanic lineages, rock is the oldest witness. C# is its voice — slow, sure, unchanging as granite under your feet.
Musicologists find C# in funeral music and collective memory across many cultures. As if the body knew: this frequency ties you to the dead without the ache of leaving them.
Listen to C# when you need to feel continuity — that you are a link, not a beginning. The ancestors are not dead. They are the silence you grow from.
D: D is the note that dreams while awake. It lives on the line between the visible and what you only half sense.
Renaissance luthiers avoided D in court music — they said it kindled the imagination so strongly that listeners were carried away in thought.
In Celtic practice D was the bard’s note. Sung before sleep, it was said to open the door to dreams that read the future.
Contemporary research in sound therapy shows that frequencies around 293 Hz can slow the prefrontal cortex — the same part that chokes off creative thought.
D does not ask. D suggests. It is the note that says: what if? Listen when you feel stuck. It will find the doors you cannot see.
D#: D# does not ask whether it is allowed to feel glad. It is simply glad. It is the note that remembers: joy does not need a reason.
Lullabies everywhere — from Japan to Brazil — orbit the frequency of D#. That sound says: you are safe. You may sleep now. You may laugh now.
Children sing in D# before anyone teaches them. It is the body’s own key — the first music before a word is spoken.
Inner-child work often uses high, clear tones to restore contact with joy from before the wound. D# is a central frequency for that.
D# asks: when did you last play for no reason? Do not meet it with the mind. Leave a little of yourself to chance. It will do the rest.
E: E is the note no one wants to hear — and everyone needs. It is the sound of what hurts.
Greek tragedies used E in the chorus in scenes of mourning. They believed that note could draw grief from the body instead of damming it up.
In flamenco, E is the heart of the duende — the elusive force that makes the music shatter the heart and mend it in the same bar.
Sound therapists work with E in trauma. Not because it is pleasant — because it is true.
E is honest. It does not pretend the world is fine. If you listen and something in you shudders, that is it working. Let it shudder.
F: F is a place to come back to. Not a house of brick — a house of sound.
Medieval cathedrals were built so their space naturally rings near F. The builders knew: that tone helps people feel safe.
In Indian music, F (Ma) is the mother’s note — steady, caring, always there beneath the line like the ground under your step.
Research finds F reduces cortisol faster than almost any other single note. A frequency that tells the nervous system: you may downshift.
F is not thrilling. It will not lead you out into the unknown. F is the arms that have been open. Return when the world is too loud.
F#: F# is not in a rush to have answers. It does not need them too soon. It is the note of questions — open, spacious, in love with the search.
Persian and Indian instruments of contemplation were often tuned so the still point of a melody would fall near F#. There the line stops looking outward and starts to listen inward.
F# straddles two keys — not quite major, not quite minor. That in-between is not a gap. It is a space large enough to hold a question before it hardens into belief.
People describe F# as the note that opens a window — you see more than a moment before. Not a new answer, but a new way to ask.
Use F# when you know you are looking for something but you cannot name it. It will not hand you a map. It can teach you to like walking.
G: G is always already elsewhere. The note of the horizon — it pulls you, and you never quite catch it.
Troubadours sang in G on the roads between castles. They said the road feels shorter — not by magic, but because the step begins to move of its own accord.
G is the dominant in Western harmony — the note that yearns to go home, and yet roams the whole world on the way.
Clinicians use G with depression and flat affect. The frequency nudges the brain’s reward-anticipation circuits — so tomorrow can feel worth the trip again.
G asks: where to next? It does not wait. It is already in motion. Listen when you are bogged down.
G#: G# is what the body knows before the mind names it. The range of rain, wood, the breath in soil — everything that restores without a permit slip.
Tibetan bowls, didgeridoo, and many rattles and drums stack harmonics near G#. The body answers before you finish thinking the word ‘heal.’
Biofeedback studies show sounds near 415 Hz can align heart rate and breath, engaging the branch of the nervous system that mends and rests.
G# does not ‘fix’ you. It makes the room in which the body can do its work — the way a field does not make the flower, but it allows the bloom.
Return to G# when you are tired in a way sleep does not fix. A tired below sleep. G# meets that from underneath.
A: A is the note against which the rest of the system is heard. A reference. A still point. A self.
The argument over 440 Hz versus 432 Hz is old. One camp claims 432 is ‘natural.’ Another calls that a story. A keeps its counsel. The truth, it whispers, is in who listens, not the figure on a dial.
In Sufi lineages, A is tied to self-seeing — a tone used in practices that invite the student to look at the ego without verdict.
A engages the hearing cortex more quickly than other single tones — a reason it became the default tuning note. The brain has rehearsed A longest.
When you take A in, you hear a self that is not the face you file under ‘public.’ A quieter, steadier one that was always in the room. A does not flatter. It does not have to.
A#: A# does not turn the volume down for you. It is the note of anger with a case — and it is aware of the brief.
Protest and lament on every landmass reach for the sharp side of the scale. It is not always theory; sometimes the body simply has to go sharp when the cup runs over.

Anger that is never said out loud does not go away. It rots in place — a quiet undermining, a clench that will not unclasp, a long flat ‘fine.’ A# is one corridor where that pressure can be moved without a verdict on your character.
At slightly sharp, very high register, the amygdala — the old emotional suite — is often poked. A# is not here to hush. It is here to wake. That is not cruelty; it is a kind of service.
Call on A# when the smile has outlasted the truth. When a voice in you is owed airtime. It is not a coach for volume. It is a gauge for *when*.
B: B is in the doorway, looking up and down the stair. It does not check whether you brought your good shoes.
In tonal harmony B is leaning — it wants a resolution up or down, rarely a long stand on the ledge. The note that will not let the story settle where you left it.
High, thin, tuned-for-transition: many rites of passage in many cultures have lifted people into a similar band. A frequency for shedding an old name.
At roughly four hundred ninety cycles per second, some people report a brief lift in watchfulness — the sense that a hinge is about to show itself.

B is not for all hours. Use it at the edge of a decision you are afraid to write down. It will not erase fear. It can, sometimes, help you go through the door without pretending the stairs were not there.

the-vessel.tagline: The vessel remembers what the mind cannot name yet.
the-vessel.description: This card reveals the inner tension between silence and listening. It calls you to read your interior and invites you to pause.
the-vessel.meaningUpright:
Inner guidance
Awakening intention
A space for truth
the-vessel.meaningShadow:
Stuck in illusion
Scattered light
Fear of seeing clearly
the-vessel.affirmation: Even when I doubt, I stay faithful to truth.

the-spiral.tagline: There is no return, only deeper return.
the-spiral.description: A symbol of ongoing evolution: the path does not end, it deepens. Spiral learning is repetition with new understanding.
the-spiral.meaningUpright:
Soul growth
Integration of experience
Movement toward center
the-spiral.meaningShadow:
Lost in loops
Fear of change
Escaping depth
the-spiral.affirmation: I circle, but I do not wander. I return deeper.

the-return.tagline: Every return is a new birth.
the-return.description: Return is not regression, it is rebirth with memory. When you return, you are no longer the same.
the-return.meaningUpright:
Reintegration
Revaluing the past
Consent to your own path
the-return.meaningShadow:
Trapped in nostalgia
Denying change
Emptiness after the road
the-return.affirmation: I returned to remember who I became.

the-seed.tagline: A beginning is a decision, not a plan.
the-seed.description: A seed does not know it will become a tree. It still says yes.
the-seed.meaningUpright:
Initiation
Intuitive decision
Faith without proof
the-seed.meaningShadow:
Fear of starting
Need for control
Procrastination

the-watcher.tagline: I see. I do not judge.
the-watcher.description: The witness does not intervene, it keeps watch. Seeing without judgment is an act of love.
the-watcher.meaningShadow:
Passivity
Hidden judgment
Fear of engagement
the-watcher.affirmation: I look with the heart. I do not need to act.

the-path.tagline: Not a place, but a way of being.
the-path.description: The path is more than a route, it is a relationship with movement. The journey is a way of thinking.
the-path.meaningShadow:
Lost
Comparing paths
Cut off from purpose

the-echo.description: Echo is the world answering your voice. Not the same, but related.
the-echo.meaningUpright:
Understanding impact
Spiritual communication
A sign from the ether
the-echo.meaningShadow:
Not listening
Fear of the answer
Repeating old mistakes
the-echo.affirmation: What I hear is an answer to my call.

the-pulse.tagline: Rhythm is the presence of the heart.
the-pulse.description: Pulse is more than heartbeat, it is a spiritual beat. Synchronization with Life.
the-pulse.meaningUpright:
Life force
Synchronization
Feeling the rhythm
the-pulse.meaningShadow:
Overstimulation
Irregular rhythm
Losing touch with the body
the-pulse.affirmation: I beat in the rhythm of Life.

the-lightkeeper.tagline: Light is not kept. Light is carried.
the-lightkeeper.description: The Lightkeeper does not hoard light. It carries it so someone else can find the way.
the-lightkeeper.affirmation: I am not the light, but I carry it.

the-wave.tagline: Surrender. You are the wave, not the barrier.
the-wave.description: Do not block it, let it pass. The wave moves through you, not from you.
the-wave.affirmation: I allow the wave to pass through.
